verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents a REST API, authenticated with secret keys, that covers some lifecycle actions: refunding purchases and granting promotional entitlements (docs-19), and importing purchases via `POST /receipts` (docs-21). New subscriptions are created through the SDK's `purchase(package:)` call routed to the app stores (docs-14), not through a server-side create endpoint. The MCP server and AI toolkit manage configuration such as products and entitlements, not individual customer subscriptions (docs-8, docs-9). Missing for 10: documented API endpoints to update a subscription's plan or price, to pause, and to cancel; a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404); and hands-on corroboration that the full lifecycle can be run without the dashboard.
